spec.title: Pricing options tailored to Zoominfo's preferences
spec.lead: Choose between a fixed-scope milestone build or flexible velocity engineering pods.
spec.notes: We offer three commercial models so ZoomInfo can balance budget certainty against backlog flexibility. Option A provides a fixed-price 12-week outcome delivery, Option B provides a flexible time-and-materials velocity pod, and Option C combines the platform build with our Cloud Evolve managed services.
